papers.title: First Report of Tenacibaculum maritimum Infection in Grouper ( Epinephelus spp.) Aquaculture in Taiwan
papers.authors: Wu, Shang‐Ting; Hsieh, Chia‐Yu
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Between April 2024 and 2025, six independent outbreaks of ulcerative skin disease occurred in cultured groupers ( Epinephelus spp.) across southern Taiwan and Penghu County during winter‐to‐spring seasonal transitions at water temperatures ranging from 19°C to 24°C. Affected fish presented with extensive epidermal erosion and deep dermal ulceration on the operculum, lateral trunk and caudal peduncle regions. Histopathology revealed marked integumentary breakdown characterised by epithelial sloughing, deep dermal necrosis and dense basophilic mats of filamentous bacteria tracking along necrotic subcutaneous myofibres. Wet‐mount microscopy and Gram‐stained lesion smears consistently revealed sheets of long, slender, Gram‐negative rods across all cases ( n = 18). Eighteen representative isolates exhibiting pale‐yellow, flat, adherent colonies with irregular margins were recovered on Marine Agar formulated with natural seawater (salinity 30‰–35‰). Species‐specific PCR and near‐full‐length 16S rRNA gene sequencing (1505 bp; > 99.5% identity to the type strain NCIMB 2154 T ) confirmed the aetiology to be Tenacibaculum maritimum . Physiological profiling revealed a narrow salinity tolerance window (30‰–45‰), in contrast to the broader range of classic temperate strains (10‰–35‰). This study represents the first definitive isolation and molecular/physiological characterisation of T. maritimum in farmed groupers in Taiwan, expanding its host spectrum and geographical range into subtropical mariculture zones.
papers.summary_cn: 2024年4月至2025年间，台湾南部及澎湖县养殖石斑鱼（Epinephelus spp.）在冬春交替、水温19–24°C条件下发生6起独立溃疡性皮肤病暴发，病灶表现为表皮广泛糜烂及真皮深层溃疡，组织病理显示上皮脱落、真皮坏死及丝状细菌沿坏死皮下肌纤维分布。通过特异性PCR及16S rRNA基因测序（与模式菌株NCIMB 2154^T同源性>99.5%）确认病原为Tenacibaculum maritimum，生理 profiling 显示其耐盐窗口较窄（30‰–45‰），有别于温带经典菌株（10‰–35‰）。本研究首次在台湾养殖石斑鱼中分离并完成T. maritimum的分子与生理学鉴定，扩展了该病原的宿主谱及地理分布至亚热带海水养殖区。

papers.title: Neuropeptide Regulation of Aquaporin Intracellular Trafficking in Marine Teleost Rectal Enterocytes
papers.authors: Chauvigné, François; Toala-Franco, Daniel; Rey-Alfonso, Àngel; Catalán-García, Marc; Finn, Roderick Nigel; Cerdà, Joan
papers.abstract: In marine teleosts, the neuroendocrine regulation of aquaporin intracellular trafficking in osmoregulatory organs such as the intestinal rectum remains underexplored. By using paralog-specific antibodies, here we determined the subcellular localization of seven aquaporin and aquaglyceroporin paralogs in the rectal enterocytes of the marine teleost gilthead seabream (Sparus aurata) and investigated the neuropeptinergic effects of arginine vasopressin (Avp) and oxytocin (Oxt) on channel trafficking. The data reveal that Aqp1aa, -1ab2 and -3a are mainly localized in the cytoplasm and basolateral membranes of the enterocytes, while Aqp1ab1, -10bb and -14 are cytoplasmatic and also present in the apical plasma membrane microvilli. In contrast, Aqp0a localizes in the enterocyte subapical cytoplasm. Treatment of rectal explants with Avp in vitro increases the targeting of Aqp1ab1, -1ab2, -10bb and -14, but not of Aqp0a, -1aa and -3a, to the enterocyte apical microvilli, which involves protein kinase A (PKA)-mediated phosphorylation of the channel subdomains. In addition, we find that the differential interaction of the Aqp1ab-type paralogs with teleost-specific 14-3-3ζ-like binding proteins is associated with the trafficking of the channels to the apical microvilli membranes. Conversely, Oxt treatment does not affect the subcellular distribution of any of the investigated aquaporins, except Aqp14, which is internalized in response to the neuropeptide by a partially independent protein kinase C pathway. These data suggest that Avp-PKA signaling controls plasma membrane trafficking of several seabream rectal aquaporins, possibly to facilitate water and solute fluxes across the enterocyte membrane.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究探究了神经内分泌因子对海水硬骨鱼直肠肠上皮细胞中aquaporin胞内转运的调控机制。利用旁系同源特异性抗体，研究确定了七种aquaporin/aquaglyceroporin在gilthead seabream（Sparus aurata）直肠肠上皮细胞中的亚细胞定位，并检测了arginine vasopressin（Avp）和oxytocin（Oxt）对通道转运的影响。结果显示，Avp通过PKA介导的磷酸化促进Aqp1ab1、-1ab2、-10bb和-14向肠上皮细胞顶端微绒毛的靶向转运，且Aqp1ab型旁系同源物与14-3-3ζ样结合蛋白的差异互作参与该过程；而Oxt仅引起Aqp14的内化。结果表明Avp-PKA信号通路调控多种海鲷直肠aquaporin的质膜转运，可能有助于跨肠上皮细胞膜的水和溶质通量。

papers.title: Effects of Pretreatment on the Isotopic Composition of Structural Carbonate in Ray‐Finned Fish Teeth
papers.authors: Furuya, Toshikazu; Yokouchi, Kazuki; Okumura, Taiga; Shirai, Kotaro
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Rationale The carbon and oxygen stable isotope ratios (δ 13 C and δ 18 O) of carbonate contained in fish tooth dentin have the potential to offer insights into environmental and ecological conditions, making them promising targets for analysis in fossil specimens. However, the tooth dentin of extant specimens contains significant amounts of organic matter that can decompose or produce gases that interfere with isotope measurements. Therefore, a well‐developed pretreatment protocol for removing organic components prior to isotopic analysis is essential. Methods In this study, we developed pretreatment methods for removing organic matter to enable the isotopic analysis of structural carbonates in tooth dentin. Using teeth of the half‐smooth golden pufferfish ( Lagocephalus spadiceus ) as specimens, we applied a total of eight physical and chemical pretreatment protocols and evaluated their effects on carbonate isotopic composition. Results Treatments with neutral or alkaline pancreatin solutions effectively removed organic matter without altering the δ 13 C values of the carbonate. In contrast, no pretreatment method was identified that kept δ 18 O values entirely unaffected. However, treatment with the neutral pancreatin solution resulted in sufficient removal of organic matter and only minimal, consistent changes in δ 18 O. Conclusions Treatments with neutral or alkaline pancreatin solutions are recommended for the analysis of δ 13 C in carbonate within dentin. Although no method for ideal organic matter removal without changing δ 18 O values was identified, treatment with neutral pancreatin solution is recommended as the second‐best option. Because of the small and consistent change in δ 18 O, it is possible to correct for δ 18 O alterations induced by pretreatment.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究旨在建立鱼牙本质结构碳酸盐稳定同位素分析前的有机质去除预处理方案。以半滑金河豚（Lagocephalus spadiceus）牙齿为材料，测试了8种物理和化学预处理流程对碳酸盐δ13C和δ18O组成的影响。中性和碱性胰蛋白酶溶液可有效去除有机质且不改变δ13C值，但所有方法均无法完全避免δ18O变化；中性胰蛋白酶处理引起的δ18O变化最小且一致，可通过校正消除。推荐中性或碱性胰蛋白酶处理用于牙本质碳酸盐δ13C分析，中性胰蛋白酶处理作为δ18O分析次优选择。

papers.title: Promoting sustainable fishing: from the perspective of Fisheries Funding Mechanism under the Agreement on Fisheries Subsidies
papers.authors: Bai, Jiayu; Guo, Muyun; Zhao, Min
papers.abstract: With widespread depletion of the world’s marine resources, the sustainable fishing has risen more and more concern on a global scale. After rounds of hard negotiations, the World Trade Organization (WTO) adopted the Agreement on Fisheries Subsidies (AFS) on June 17, 2022. This agreement came into force on September 15, 2025. It aims to promote ocean sustainability by prohibiting harmful fisheries subsidies. Recognizing the factual constraints and development needs of some developing country Members, the AFS provides Special and Differential Treatment (SDT) for them. According to Article 7 of the AFS, the WTO established a Fisheries Funding Mechanism to provide developing and least developed country (LDC) Members with targeted technical assistance and capacity building for the purpose of implementing the disciplines under the Agreement. By normative analysis and interdisciplinary approach, this study reviews this Funding Mechanism and determines potential operational challenges, including unpredictable financing, administrative and technical access barriers, vague prioritization and allocation procedures, monitoring, evaluation and learning gaps, and coordination risks. It further proposes certain refinements to enhance transparency, access, and long-term effectiveness. These include clearer prioritization criteria, simplified application procedures, more reliable funding sources, and stronger monitoring and coordination frameworks. A well-functioning assistance system will offer technical and financial aid to support countries in need, enable them to build their national capacity, therefore better complying with the fisheries subsidy disciplines while ensuring their sufficient development space, ultimately helping to achieve the goal of marine sustainable development.
papers.summary_cn: 本文评析WTO《渔业补贴协定》（AFS）下的渔业资助机制，该协定于2025年9月15日生效，通过禁止有害渔业补贴促进海洋可持续性，并为发展中国家和最不发达国家成员提供特殊与差别待遇（SDT）。研究采用规范分析与跨学科方法，识别该机制面临的潜在运行挑战，包括资金来源不可预测、行政与技术准入障碍、优先次序和分配程序模糊、监测评估与学习缺口及协调风险。文章提出明确优先标准、简化申请程序、拓宽可靠资金来源和强化监测协调框架等改进建议，以提升透明度、可及性与长期有效性，帮助有需求国家建设能力、遵守补贴纪律并实现海洋可持续发展目标。

papers.title: Connecting and coordinating fisheries projects to advance problem solving: Using the SCAALE (Strategic Connections Applied Across Leveraged Evaluations) framework
papers.authors: Hitchman, Sean M; Mather, Martha E; Oliver, Devon C; DeVries, Dennis R; Krogman, Rebecca M; Smith, Joseph M; Loubere, Alex D; Conroy, Joseph D; Carey, Michael P; Pope, Kevin L
papers.abstract: Abstract A persistent challenge in fisheries is that field data sets from related studies are often difficult to compare and extend across years and systems. Examples include (1) surveys of native or invasive organisms conducted in one watershed may not predict trends in another watershed; (2) fish stocking protocols that result in high survival in one year may not produce the same results in subsequent years; and (3) data from single-period, single-location creel surveys may not represent angler attitudes, reactions, or preferences in other systems at other times. In our Strategic Connections Applied Across Leveraged Evaluations (SCAALE) framework, we develop a general model to address the knowledge gaps of how to better link related data sets, coordinate relevant perspectives, and merge individual data streams across years, systems, and taxa. We apply SCAALE to three case studies and show an example of the framework for fisheries agency planning. Whereas some external barriers to multi-study strategic planning can be modified through professional resolve (e.g., lack of training in strategic project planning), other barriers may require more extensive discussions (e.g., how funding is allocated). The SCAALE framework provides a relevant and practical approach that manager–researcher–administrator teams could use to advance data syntheses across years, systems, species, and projects. Our perspective initiates this profession-wide conversation.
papers.summary_cn: 针对渔业研究中相关数据集跨年份、跨系统难以比较和整合的问题，提出SCAALE（Strategic Connections Applied Across Leveraged Evaluations）框架，旨在链接相关数据集、协调各方视角并整合跨年份、系统和类群的独立数据流。通过三个案例研究展示该框架的应用，并给出渔业机构规划示例。研究指出部分多研究战略规划的外部障碍可通过专业决心克服（如战略项目规划培训不足），其他障碍（如资金分配方式）则需更广泛讨论。该框架为管理者—研究者—行政人员团队推进跨年份、系统、物种和项目的数据综合提供了实用方法。

papers.title: Fish helminth fauna of the Debed River  of the Lori Region of Armenia
papers.authors: Hovhannisyan, R. L.; Shcherbakov, O V.; Vardanyan, M. V.; Rukhkyan, M. Ya.
papers.abstract: The study of the fish helminth fauna of the Debed Rive rand the detection of fish infection by helminths. The material was collected in 2023. A total of 92 individuals of 4 fish species from the Debed River were examined. Helminthological examination of fish, collection and cameral processing of helminths were carried out according to generally accepted methods. Statistical processing of the results was carried out using the "vassarstats.net" online software. The work was performed at the Scientific Centre of Zoology and Hydroecology, National Academy of Sciences, Republic of Armenia. Six species of helminths were detected in the examined fish examined from the Debed River, including 1 species of trematodes, 2 species of cestodes, 2 species of nematodes and 1 species of acanthocephalans. The total infection of fish by helminths was 51 %. Quantitative characteristics of fish infection by helminths have been determined. A higher infection of fish was observed by metacercariae of the trematode Diplostomum sp. (40.9 %), cestode Schyzocotyle acheilognathi (25.0 %) and plerocercoids of cestode Ligula intestinalis (15.0 %). Metacercariae of the trematode Diplostomum sp. were found in the lenses of all fish species. A greater number of the helminth species discovered in khramicarp. A brief information on fish infection by detected helminths is given. The helminth fauna of fish in the Debed River is characterised by poor species diversity. The formation of the species composition of fish helminths and changes in the infection of fish by helminths depend on the degree and nature of the complex impact of various environmental factors in the study area, both natural and anthropogenic. The most pathogenic species of helminths for fish were identified. They are the causative agents of ligulosis and diplostomosis, causing significant harm to the fish and often leading to their death.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究调查了亚美尼亚洛里地区Debed河鱼类的蠕虫区系及感染情况，于2023年采集4种92尾鱼，按标准寄生虫学方法进行检查。共检出6种蠕虫（1种吸虫、2种绦虫、2种线虫、1种棘头虫），总感染率为51%；以Diplostomum sp.囊蚴（40.9%）、Schyzocotyle acheilognathi（25.0%）和Ligula intestinalis裂头蚴（15.0%）感染率较高，Diplostomum sp.囊蚴见于所有鱼种的眼晶状体。该河鱼类蠕虫区系物种多样性较低，其组成和感染变化受自然与人为环境因素综合影响；Ligula intestinalis和Diplostomum sp.为致病性最强的种类，可造成显著危害甚至死亡。

papers.title: Postbiotics as Regulators of Gene Expression and Enzymatic Activity in Fish and Shellfish: Implications for Growth, Immunity, and Reproduction
papers.authors: Ahmadifar, Ehsan; Khanzadeh, Majid; Hosseini, Saeedeh; Chandran, Deepak; Abdul Kalam Saleena, Lejaniya; Soo Oi Yoona, Michelle
papers.abstract: Postbiotics, a novel class of non-viable probiotic-derived feed additives, are emerging as a promising, sustainable alternative to antibiotics and live probiotics in aquaculture. Comprising inactivated microbial cells, cell wall components, and microbial metabolites (e.g., cell-free supernatants, short-chain fatty acids, and bacteriocins), postbiotics have been shown in laboratory and animal studies to enhance growth, modulate immune responses, improve gut health and microbiome balance, and increase disease resistance in fish and shellfish. Compared with live microbes, postbiotics offer greater physicochemical stability and lower risk of transferring antimicrobial-resistance genes, which improves their suitability for farm applications. Nevertheless, significant limitations remain: lack of standardized production and dosing protocols, incomplete understanding of cellular and systemic mechanisms of action, scarce species- and life-stage-specific efficacy data, and a shortage of long-term environmental and field evaluations. This review synthesizes current preparation methods, active components, and evidence of biological activity for postbiotics, identifies key research gaps, and highlights priorities such as diversified formulations, exploration of synergistic combinations with other feed additives, standardization of experimental approaches, and expanded field trials to bridge laboratory findings with practical aquaculture use.
papers.summary_cn: 该综述聚焦后生元（postbiotics）作为水产养殖中替代抗生素和活益生菌的新型非活性饲料添加剂，系统梳理了其制备方法、活性成分（灭活菌体、细胞壁组分、无细胞上清、短链脂肪酸、细菌素等）及在鱼贝类中促进生长、调节免疫、改善肠道菌群和增强抗病力的生物学证据。与活菌相比，后生元理化稳定性更高且耐药基因转移风险更低，更适于养殖应用。但当前仍存在生产与给药方案缺乏标准化、作用机制认识不足、物种及生活史阶段特异性数据稀缺、长期环境与田间评估缺乏等局限，作者据此提出剂型多样化、与其他饲料添加剂协同组合、实验方法标准化及扩大田间试验等优先研究方向。

papers.title: Edible insect-based feed ingredients as modulators of gastrointestinal physiology in monogastric livestock and aquaculture species
papers.authors: Sánchez-Velázquez, Oscar Abel; Hernández-Álvarez, Alan Javier
papers.abstract: Edible insects have emerged as promising sustainable feed ingredients capable of supporting both animal production and gastrointestinal health. Beyond their nutritional value, insect-derived meals contain bioactive compounds—including chitin, antimicrobial peptides, medium-chain fatty acids, micronutrients, and antioxidant molecules—that may modulate gut microbiota–host interactions in farmed monogastric animal species. This review critically examines current evidence on the mechanisms through which insect-based diets influence gastrointestinal physiology in livestock and aquaculture species. Available studies indicate that dietary insect inclusion can promote beneficial shifts in gut microbial communities, including increased bacterial diversity, enrichment of short-chain fatty acid-producing taxa, and reductions in selected opportunistic pathogens. However, these responses are not uniform across experimental models and depend on factors including insect species, processing method, dietary inclusion level, host species, age, and physiological status. Rather than acting through isolated mechanisms, insect-derived bioactive compounds function as an integrated nutritional matrix that simultaneously influences microbial metabolism, epithelial signaling, and immune regulation. Future standardized and multi-omics studies will be essential to identify the principal bioactive compounds responsible for these physiological effects and to optimize insect-derived functional ingredients for precision animal nutrition and more sustainable livestock and aquaculture production.
papers.summary_cn: 本文综述食用昆虫作为可持续饲料原料对单胃家畜和水产养殖动物胃肠道生理的调控作用。昆虫源饲料中的几丁质、抗菌肽、中链脂肪酸及抗氧化物质等生物活性成分可调节肠道微生物与宿主互作，现有研究表明日粮添加昆虫可提高肠道菌群多样性、富集产短链脂肪酸菌群并抑制部分条件致病菌。这些效应受昆虫种类、加工方式、添加水平及宿主种类和生理状态影响，并非单一机制介导。未来需通过标准化和多组学研究鉴定关键活性成分，以优化昆虫源功能性饲料原料在精准动物营养和可持续养殖中的应用。

papers.title: Evaluating the influences of fishmeal replacement on growth, immune and nutritional performance in aquaculture
papers.authors: Faseeha, Inshrah; Khaliq, Aiza; Hamid, Majid; Mubeen, Noor e
papers.abstract: Aquaculture serves as an auspicious protein source for the human consumption. To cultivate aquatic organism proficiently, the prepared feed should have eminence protein constituents. Feed for aquatic animals contain raw fish as a main product e.g fish oil and fishmeal that gained from the whole fish and its remains. The fish silage is feasible for using in feed after their bioconversion or transformation. Feed for aquatic animals includes raw fish as a primary ingredient, such as fish oil and fishmeal obtained from whole fish and their by-products. Fish silage can be used in feed after undergoing bioconversion or processing. This impending ingredient is the main cost effective component of the whole feed of fish. In this review we discuss the alternative protein sources in the fish feed based on plant or animal, that can reduce the budget and improved the fish efficacy, effective for the sustainability of aquaculture for low to high scale farming. Production of aquaculture inflates worldwide to meet the demand of world for protein (fish, seafood etc.). Hence, investigation on low cost substitute protein sources of fishmeal was prolific, provide good information that could be helpful for the small fish farmers.
papers.summary_cn: 本文综述了水产饲料中鱼粉替代蛋白源（植物源或动物源）对鱼类生长、免疫及营养性能的影响，旨在降低饲料成本并提升养殖效益。鱼粉和鱼油作为水产饲料的主要成分成本较高，鱼青贮等生物转化产物可作为潜在替代原料。综述指出，低成本替代蛋白源的研究可为小规模养殖户提供有价值的信息，有助于水产养殖的可持续性发展。

papers.title: Parasitic diseases of marine fishes and their impact on human health: focus on the Egyptian biosphere: A review
papers.authors: Nashaat, Mai
papers.summary_cn: 该综述聚焦埃及海域海洋鱼类的寄生虫病及其对人类健康的影响，系统梳理了相关寄生虫种类、感染途径与公共卫生风险，但缺乏具体研究数据与方法描述。

papers.title: Paralytic shellfish toxin production in Alexandrium minutum (Dinophyceae): Insights from omics integration using toxigenic and nontoxigenic recombinant progeny
papers.authors: Mary, Lou; Quere, Julien; Latimier, Marie; Artigaud, Sébastien; Hégaret, Hélène; Le Gac, Mickael; Réveillon, Damien
papers.abstract: Abstract Paralytic shellfish toxins (PSTs) are produced by certain species of cyanobacteria and dinoflagellates. Part of the PST biosynthetic pathway has been elucidated in cyanobacteria, and the implication of some sxt genes has been confirmed by experimental studies. Contrary to cyanobacteria, knowledge about PST biosynthesis in dinoflagellates is more limited and generally restricted to comparative studies with the cyanobacterial pathway. To investigate the specificity of the PST pathway in dinoflagellates, 16 toxigenic and nontoxigenic Alexandrium minutum strains from a recombinant cross were compared, without prior assumption about genes or metabolites involved in PST synthesis, using an integrative approach combining untargeted metabolomic and transcriptomic data. Among the 60 most distinguishing transcripts between toxigenic and non‐toxigenic strains, only three sxt genes were present: sxt A4, sxt G, and sxt I. In contrast, non‐ sxt homologs were detected as highly discriminant between these two phenotypes. More specifically, a phy H homolog may act as the analog of the sxt S gene observed in cyanobacteria. Moreover, we identified four putative synthetic PST intermediates. Among these, Int‐C'2 correlated with the toxic phenotype, whereas three others were detected in both toxigenic and nontoxigenic strains, suggesting that these strains may share some parts of the biosynthetic pathway. Finally, our analyses identified both horizontally gained sxt genes and endogenous genes, including the candidate gene phy H, as candidate components of the PST biosynthetic pathway in A. minutum .
papers.summary_cn: 本研究通过整合非靶向代谢组学与转录组学数据，比较了16株产毒与非产毒重组子代亚历山大藻（*Alexandrium minutum*）菌株，在未预设PST合成相关基因或代谢物的情况下探究甲藻中麻痹性贝类毒素（PST）合成途径的特异性。在60个最具判别力的转录本中仅发现3个sxt基因（sxt A4、sxt G、sxt I），而非sxt同源基因（尤其是phy H同源基因，可能为蓝藻sxt S的功能类似物）在两种表型间判别力更强。研究鉴定出4种推定PST合成中间体，其中Int-C'2与产毒表型相关，其余3种在两种菌株中均存在，提示二者可能共享部分合成途径。结果表明*A. minutum*的PST合成途径由水平获得的sxt基因与内源基因（包括候选基因phy H）共同组成。

papers.title: Comparative fish toxicology of perfluorohexanoic acid, hexafluoropropylene oxide dimer acid, and trifluoroacetic acid
papers.authors: Akhtar, Muhammad Saeed; Zaman, Wajid
papers.summary_cn: 比较全氟己酸、六氟环氧丙烷二聚酸和三氟乙酸对鱼类的毒性效应，为评估短链PFAS替代品的生态风险提供毒理学依据。

papers.title: Numerical investigation of fish swimming performance response under artificial reef–induced flow fields in the upper reaches of the Yangtze River
papers.authors: Yang, Guang; Zhang, Junfeng; Yan, Ruiqi; Du, Hongbo; Zhang, Xianbing; Li, Wenjie; Wan, Yu
papers.summary_cn: 该研究通过数值模拟方法，探究长江上游人工鱼礁诱导流场下鱼类的游泳性能响应，旨在评估人工鱼礁流场对鱼类行为的影响机制。

papers.title: Toward evidence-based fish welfare regulation: policy lessons from Chile, Norway, and Scotland
papers.authors: Valdés, Juan Antonio
papers.abstract: Aquaculture has become a major contributor to global food production, but its rapid expansion and intensification have increased concerns regarding the welfare of farmed fish. Although advances in welfare science have generated animal-based measures, operational welfare indicators, and increasingly sophisticated monitoring technologies, their incorporation into regulatory frameworks remains uneven. This review examines the evolution of fish welfare regulation and compares the regulatory approaches of Chile, Norway, and Scotland, three major salmon-producing jurisdictions representing distinct models of welfare governance. The analysis distinguishes between legislation that directly establishes welfare obligations and sanitary, environmental, biosecurity, and production regulations that indirectly influence welfare determinants. Chile combines explicit legal recognition of fish welfare with an extensive sanitary and environmental regulatory architecture, although standardized animal-based welfare assessment, intervention criteria, and welfare-specific auditing remain limited. Norway is characterized by the direct incorporation of detailed welfare requirements into aquaculture regulation, complemented by structured monitoring, documentation, and science-based assessment tools. Scotland represents a more distributed model in which statutory welfare duties are complemented by aquaculture and animal-health legislation, government guidance, industry codes, and scientific assessment tools. Importantly, differences in regulatory operationalization should not be interpreted as evidence of differences in regulatory effectiveness, which requires independent evaluation through measurable welfare outcomes. Based on this comparison, we propose Evidence-Based Welfare Regulation (EBWR) as an integrative regulatory framework connecting legal welfare objectives with evidence-qualified resource-, management-, and animal-based indicators, standardized monitoring, context-specific thresholds or reference ranges, corrective actions, outcome verification, and periodic scientific review. Rather than introducing a new welfare-assessment methodology, EBWR integrates existing scientific and regulatory tools within an adaptive feedback system. For Chile, this transition could build on existing regulatory and institutional capacities through species-specific welfare standards, evidence-qualified operational welfare indicators, risk-based monitoring, outcome verification, and adaptive regulatory review.
papers.summary_cn: 本文综述智利、挪威和苏格兰三个主要鲑鱼生产辖区的鱼类福利监管演变，区分直接设定福利义务的立法与间接影响福利的卫生、环境及生物安全法规。智利将鱼类福利纳入法律承认但缺乏标准化动物基福利评估与审计；挪威将详细福利要求直接纳入水产养殖法规并配套结构化监测与科学评估工具；苏格兰则采用法定福利职责与行业规范、政府指南相结合的分散模式。作者据此提出Evidence-Based Welfare Regulation (EBWR)框架，将法律福利目标与证据合格指标、标准化监测、情境化阈值、纠正措施及定期科学审查整合为自适应反馈系统，并建议智利依托现有监管能力推进物种特异性福利标准与基于风险的监测。

papers.title: Motif dan Perilaku Konsumen dalam Praktik Membungkus Sisa Makanan (Doggy Bagging) di Restoran Tsania Seafood Kota Batam
papers.authors: Muhammad jodi; Eryd Saputra; Arina Luthfini Lubis; Frangky Silitonga
papers.abstract: Food waste is a problem in the sustainability of the food system, including restaurants that produce leftovers after consumption. One effort to reduce food waste is to pack up and take-home food that is still edible, a practice known as “doggy bagging.” This decision is not only related to economic considerations and the desire to avoid waste but also involves emotional experiences, social norms, the condition of the food, the likelihood of future consumption, and interactions with the restaurant. This study aims to understand consumers’ motives and experiences regarding “doggy bagging” at Tsania Seafood Restaurant in Batam City, specifically in terms of how they perceive leftover food, consider the decision to pack it up, and interact with restaurant staff. The study employs a qualitative approach using Interpretative Phenomenological Analysis (IPA) within a constructivist paradigm. Informants were selected through purposive sampling and consisted of six consumers who had experience with doggy bagging. Data were collected through participatory observation and semi-structured in-depth interviews, then analyzed idiographically. The results of the study revealed four main themes: leftover food retains value; taking food home extends the possibility of consumption; doggy bagging is socially negotiated and can be normalized; and restaurants serve as a context that either facilitates or hinders this practice. The decision to take food home is situational and influenced by taste, the food’s suitability, the likelihood of consumption at home, storage, the amount of leftovers, social norms, and staff responses. Implicitly, restaurants can support doggy bagging by providing practical containers and friendly service.
papers.summary_cn: 该研究探讨印尼巴淡岛Tsania Seafood餐厅消费者打包剩余食物（doggy bagging）的动机与体验，采用解释现象学分析（IPA）对6名有打包经验的消费者进行参与式观察和半结构化深度访谈。结果归纳出四个主题：剩余食物仍有价值、带回家可延长消费可能性、doggy bagging具有社会协商性并可被正常化、餐厅环境促进或阻碍该行为。打包决策受口味、食物适宜性、家中消费可能性、储存条件、剩余量、社会规范及员工态度等情境因素影响，餐厅可通过提供实用容器和友好服务予以支持。

papers.title: A state–space model for estimating fishing and natural mortality using live mark–recapture and dead mark–recovery data
papers.authors: McCormick, Joshua L
papers.abstract: Abstract Objective The objectives of this study were to develop joint tag-recovery models that make use of both live- and dead-tag-recovery data to estimate fishing and natural mortality and allow for an evaluation of hypotheses at the individual fish scale. Such models are useful for fisheries that have relatively high rates of catch-and-release fishing in addition to harvest. Methods State–space models were developed that make use of tag-return data from fish that were harvested and/or released in a joint-likelihood model using Bayesian methods. The accuracy of the models was assessed using simulation techniques. Additionally, the models were fit to data from four fisheries in Idaho, including Smallmouth Bass Micropterus dolomieu in Dworshak Reservoir and Lake Pend Oreille, Yellow Perch Perca flavescens in Cascade Reservoir, and Lake Trout Salvelinus namaycush in Priest Lake. In addition to the null model, which contained time- and individual-invariant parameters, a time-varying model and a model that allowed fishing and natural mortality to vary based on length at tagging were also fit. Results The simulation results suggested that the state–space models were relatively unbiased and the models that used both live- and dead-tag recoveries were more accurate than those that used only harvest data. Estimated natural mortality was greater than fishing mortality at all four fisheries in the study. The direction and magnitude of the effect of length on fishing and natural mortality varied among the fisheries. The model that included length was the top model for Smallmouth Bass in Dworshak Reservoir, Yellow Perch in Cascade Reservoir, and Lake Trout in Priest Lake, whereas the time model was the top model for Smallmouth Bass in Lake Pend Oreille. Conclusions The state–space models described in this study provide a framework for estimating the demographic parameters that is more flexible than those of the previously published instantaneous rate models. The models are easily extensible to evaluate numerous hypotheses or accommodate additional data that can greatly benefit management or conservation of fisheries with concurrent harvest and catch-and-release components.
papers.summary_cn: 开发联合标签回收模型，同时利用活体标记回收与死亡标记回收数据估算捕捞死亡率和自然死亡率，并采用状态–空间模型与贝叶斯方法进行参数估计，通过模拟验证模型准确性后应用于爱达荷州四个渔业。模拟结果表明模型偏差较小，联合使用活体与死亡回收数据比仅用捕捞数据更准确；四个渔业中自然死亡率均高于捕捞死亡率，体长对死亡率的影响方向和幅度因渔业而异。该框架比传统瞬时率模型更灵活，可扩展用于评估多种假设或整合额外数据，适用于兼有捕捞与放流成分的渔业管理。

papers.title: Mercury Bioaccumulation in Fish and Associated Human Exposure Risk in an ASGM-Affected Oxbow Lake in Central Kalimantan, Indonesia
papers.authors: Gulo, Jane Oibanitehenia; Yokota, Kuriko; Elvince, Rosana; Marumoto, Kohji; Ngoc, Nguyen Minh; Inoue, Takanobu
papers.abstract: Artisanal and small-scale gold mining (ASGM) releases mercury into tropical freshwater systems, yet integrated assessments of Southeast Asian oxbow lakes remain scarce. We quantified total mercury (THg) in water, sediment, and fish from Lake Hanjalutung, an ASGM-affected oxbow lake in Central Kalimantan, Indonesia. Water and sediment were sampled at five river and lake stations in the dry (July 2025) and rainy (November 2025) seasons, and thirteen fish of five species were obtained from a lake net-cage unit in the rainy season. THg was measured by cold-vapor and thermal-decomposition atomic absorption spectrometry. Water THg was higher in the dry season (26.13–42.66 ng/L) than in the rainy season (8.20–24.05 ng/L). Geoaccumulation index (Igeo) values were higher in the lake interior (1.65–2.01) than in the river channels (0.53–1.46), consistent with Hg retention in the lake. Fish THg ranged from 0.16 to 1.51 mg/kg dw. Bioaccumulation factors (BAF; fish/water) ranged from 5.3 × 103 to 39.2 × 103 L/kg, and biota–sediment accumulation factors (BSAF; fish/sediment) exceeded unity for all species. Both indices correlated positively with body length, although this association largely reflected interspecific differences. Maximum allowable weekly intake (MAWI) estimates indicate a potential exposure risk. Intake estimated from regional data exceeded the MAWI for Wallago leeri by 9- to 12-fold for one-year-old children and approximately 8-fold for pregnant women. Preferential consumption of lower-Hg species, such as Pristolepis grootii, may increase allowable intake approximately 3.5-fold, a preliminary finding requiring confirmation.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究量化了印尼中加里曼丹受ASGM影响的牛轭湖（Lake Hanjalutung）水、沉积物和鱼类中的总汞（THg），并评估人群暴露风险。水THg旱季（26.13–42.66 ng/L）高于雨季，湖泊内部Igeo（1.65–2.01）高于河道，显示汞在湖中滞留。鱼THg为0.16–1.51 mg/kg dw，BAF为5.3×10³–39.2×10³ L/kg，所有物种BSAF均大于1，且随体长增加。MAWI估算表明存在潜在暴露风险：按区域消费数据，1岁儿童和孕妇摄入Wallago leeri分别超标约9–12倍和8倍；改食低汞种Pristolepis grootii可使允许摄入量提高约3.5倍（初步结果，待证实）。

papers.title: Nature and timing of dysregulation associated with pseudoalbinism in California Halibut, Paralichthys californicus
papers.authors: Fuiman, Lee A.; Faulk, Cynthia K.; MacNamara, Ruairi
papers.abstract: Abstract Pseudoalbinism in flatfishes, the absence of melanophores or melanin over most of the ocular side of the body, is often observed in hatcheries. The prevalence of pseudoalbinism can be very high, sometimes exceeding 90% of individuals in California Halibut, Paralichthys californicus . Pseudoalbinism is not observable prior to metamorphosis, but its prevalence is influenced by rearing conditions during the larval period. This project used quantitative real time polymerase chain reaction (qRT‐PCR) methods to measure the relative expression of eight focal genes (sox10a, sox10b, gch2, cyp26b1, aldh1a2, aldh1a3, asip1 and LOC109629521 ) in California Halibut at four developmental stages (stages F, G, H and I). Batches of halibut with a high prevalence of pseudoalbinism (94%, 97%) and intermediate prevalence (42%, 42%) were sampled. For reference, Southern Flounder (Paralichthys lethostigma ) with a low prevalence (1%, 2%) were also sampled. Strong differences in gene expression were observed at stage G, particularly gch2, asip1, cyp26b1 and sox10b . Viewing all stages together and including the low‐prevalence data for Southern Flounder revealed a sharp decrease (>10‐fold) in gch2 expression in the high prevalence group of halibut but little change in the low prevalence flounder. gch2 expression for the intermediate group became bimodal, suggesting that the final pigmentation phenotype became fixed during a narrow developmental window when halibut were 7.2–7.6 mm standard length. The observed patterns of gene expression suggest a hypothesis that pseudoalbinism in California Halibut arises at the transition from melanoblasts to mature melanophores during mid‐ to late metamorphosis (stages G and H) possibly as a result of antagonism of the melanocortin‐1 receptor (MC1R) and ectopic expression of the normal blind‐side developmental pathway. Expression of gch2 may be a candidate marker for screening for incipient pseudoalbinism, pending formal validation.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究以qRT-PCR测定加州牙鲆（Paralichthys californicus）四个发育阶段八个焦点基因的表达，比较高假性白化率（94%、97%）、中等发生率（42%）群体及低发生率（1%、2%）的南方鲽（Paralichthys lethostigma）参照群体。结果发现G期基因表达差异显著，尤其gch2、asip1、cyp26b1和sox10b；高发生率牙鲆gch2表达骤降逾10倍，而低发生率鲽变化甚微，中等群体gch2表达呈双峰分布，提示色素表型在体长7.2–7.6 mm的狭窄发育窗口内固定。作者据此提出假说：加州牙鲆假性白化源于变态中后期（G、H期）黑色素母细胞向成熟黑色素细胞转变障碍，可能与MC1R拮抗及盲侧发育通路异位表达有关，gch2表达可望作为早期筛查假性白化的候选标记。

papers.title: Effect of visual and electrosensory deterrents on captive elasmobranchs
papers.authors: Taljaard, Emily E.; Buckworth, Rik C.; Pini‐Fitzsimmons, Joni
papers.abstract: Abstract Commercial gillnet fisheries interact with a wide range of elasmobranch species, many of which are incidentally captured as bycatch. Deterrent technologies have emerged as a potential approach for reducing interactions with threatened elasmobranchs. In this exploratory study, captive Giant Shovelnose Rays ( Glaucostegus typus ) and Brownbanded Bamboo Sharks ( Chiloscyllium punctatum ) were exposed to a static green LED light and a pulsed electrosensory deterrent attached to an experimental gillnet. The light deterrent initially reduced interactions by Giant Shovelnose Rays; however, this response diminished over time. Over a 10‐min period, deterred Giant Shovelnose Rays showed a significantly greater distance of deterrence in both treatments compared to the control. There was also a significant difference in mean eye distance between the control and light treatments, but not in nose distance. In contrast, Brownbanded Bamboo Sharks exhibited no significant response to either deterrent. These contrasting responses may reflect differences in the sensory ecology of the two species, underscoring the importance of species‐specific considerations in developing elasmobranch bycatch mitigation technologies. Given the promising outcomes reported for these deterrents in other studies, and the apparent variability in responses among elasmobranch taxa, further evaluation across a broader range of bycatch species is warranted.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究在实验刺网中测试静态绿色LED灯与脉冲电感觉驱避器对圈养大犁头鳐（Glaucostegus typus）和褐带竹鲨（Chiloscyllium punctatum）的驱避效果。LED灯初期减少了大犁头鳐的交互，但响应随时间减弱；10分钟内两种处理下被驱避个体距离显著大于对照，且灯光处理组平均眼距与对照差异显著。褐带竹鲨对两种驱避器均无显著响应，反映两物种感觉生态学差异，提示bycatch缓解技术开发需考虑物种特异性，并需在更广泛混获物种中进一步评估。

papers.title: Sustainable Management of Small-Scale and Data-Limited Fisheries: Diagnosis and Strategies
papers.authors: Samy-Kamal, Mohamed; Sánchez Lizaso, José Luis
papers.abstract: Small-scale fisheries represent a critical cornerstone of global coastal livelihoods, employing over ninety percent of the world’s wild-catch fishers and contributing more than half of all marine landings globally [...]
papers.summary_cn: 本研究聚焦小规模、数据有限渔业（data-limited fisheries）的可持续管理，旨在诊断其管理困境并提出应对策略。文章指出小规模渔业雇佣了全球逾90%的野生捕捞渔民、贡献过半海洋上岸量，是沿海生计的重要支柱。摘要其余内容缺失，具体诊断方法与策略细节无法概括。

papers.title: Authentic Deeds And Notarial Accountability In Fisheries Vessel Transactions
papers.authors: Moertiono, Juli; Eri Triwanda; Ong V Russel; Frederich Zang
papers.journal: Pena Justisia: Media Komunikasi dan Kajian Hukum
papers.abstract: Illegal, unreported, and unregulated (IUU) fishing is commonly addressed through patrols, vessel monitoring, licensing controls, and criminal enforcement. These measures remain incomplete when the legal identity and ownership history of a vessel cannot be verified. This article examines the legal function of authentic deeds in fisheries-vessel transactions and clarifies the accountability of Indonesian notaries within an ownership-transparency framework. The study uses normative juridical research with statutory, conceptual, and case-oriented approaches. It analyses the Civil Code, the Commercial Code, the Notary Position Law, fisheries and shipping regulations, beneficial-ownership regulation, and relevant international law. The analysis finds that an authentic deed strengthens proof of the parties’ declarations, date, and execution, but it does not by itself establish the substantive truth of every document or guarantee lawful fishing activity. Notarial accountability therefore depends on the scope of statutory duties, professional diligence, knowledge, causation, and the distinction between formal verification and investigative enforcement. The article proposes a risk-based maritime ownership gateway that connects notarial records, ship registration, beneficial-ownership information, and fisheries licensing. The proposal is legally more defensible when implemented through interoperable verification, defined data access, audit trails, and institutional responsibility rather than through an assumption that notaries are the sole enforcement gatekeepers.
papers.summary_cn: 研究旨在探讨公证文书在渔业船舶交易中的法律功能及印尼公证人在所有权透明框架下的责任，以弥补IUU捕捞治理中船舶法律身份与所有权历史难以核实的缺口。采用规范法学研究方法，分析民法典、商法典、公证人职务法及渔业航运法规。研究发现，公证文书可强化当事人声明、日期与执行的证明力，但本身不能确立文件实质真实性或保证合法捕捞活动，公证责任取决于法定职责范围、职业勤勉与因果关系。文章提出建立基于风险的海事所有权网关，将公证记录、船舶登记、受益所有权信息与渔业许可互联。

papers.title: AI-Driven Digital Twin Framework for Sustainable Fisheries Management and Intelligent Aquatic Water Resource Monitoring
papers.authors: Grant, Vanessa; Chinonyerem, Confidence Adimchi
papers.journal: Asian Journal of Advanced Research and Reports
papers.abstract: Digital twins are increasingly proposed as a means of linking aquatic observations, predictive models and management decisions. Their relevance to sustainability nevertheless depends on more than the speed or accuracy of an artificial intelligence model. This critical narrative review examines the evidence connecting digital-twin architectures with capture fisheries, aquaculture and freshwater and coastal water-quality monitoring. Literature published through 30 July 2026 was selected through targeted scholarly searches, citation tracing and bibliographic verification, with particular attention to observation quality, independent validation, operational feedback and management outcomes. The synthesis distinguishes a digital model, a continuously updated digital representation and a decision-linked twin, and separates component performance from demonstrated ecological benefit. Evidence supports advances in image-based monitoring, satellite retrievals, hybrid environmental prediction and selected field deployments. It is substantially less conclusive regarding sustained stock recovery, equitable allocation or ecosystem-scale benefits attributable to a complete digital-twin system. Important limitations include imperfect observability, inappropriate spatial and temporal validation, uncertain transfer between environments, simulator-dependent policy optimisation and incomplete treatment of human behaviour. Apparent disagreement between promising technical demonstrations and limited management evidence largely reflects different endpoints and system boundaries rather than a simple conflict over technological feasibility. A federated, decision-centred framework is proposed in which traceable observations support uncertainty-aware state estimation, explicit management objectives, constrained decision support and independently audited outcomes. The framework includes staged deployment, human authorisation, local data governance and lifecycle assessment; it is an unvalidated synthesis rather than an implemented system. Near-term priorities are prospective forecasting benchmarks, comparative management trials, failure-tolerant monitoring and participatory evaluation in data-limited fisheries. Digital twins are most defensible as accountable extensions of existing environmental observation and adaptive management, not as substitutes for ecological understanding, enforceable institutions or legitimate collective decisions.
papers.summary_cn: 该综述批判性评估了数字孪生架构在捕捞渔业、水产养殖及水质监测中的应用证据，区分了数字模型、持续更新的数字表征与决策关联型孪生三个层次。现有证据支持影像监测、卫星反演和混合环境预测等技术进展，但关于种群恢复、公平分配或生态系统尺度效益的管理证据仍不充分，主要受限于可观测性不足、时空验证不当及人类行为刻画不完整。作者提出以决策为中心的联邦式框架，强调可追溯观测、不确定性感知状态估计与独立审计，并指出数字孪生应作为现有环境观测与适应性管理的可问责延伸，而非生态理解或制度安排的替代品。

papers.title: Vulnerability of Small-Scale Fisheries to Potential Storm Surge in North Borneo Island, Malaysia
papers.authors: Osman, Nurrul Fazlina; Sentian, Justin; Saleh, Ejria; Radjawane, Ivonne Milichristi
papers.abstract: Abstract Small-scale fishers were crucial for providing fresh seafood and contributing to the protein intake of coastal communities. They typically used traditional fishing methods and ventured out to the sea in small boats, often working alone or with a few family members. Despite their vital contribution to the community, small-scale fishers faced numerous challenges and were highly exposed to the effects of climate change. One of the most prevalent extreme events in Malaysia was storm surge. Therefore, this study aimed to assess the vulnerability of small-scale fisheries to potential storm surges in Kudat, Sabah, Malaysia. This study adopted the Tool for Understanding Resilience of Fisheries (TURF) to assess the climate change vulnerability of coastal fisheries across nine tropical study sites. Field interviews were conducted from March 2020 to March 2023 in Kudat, where one hundred respondents were surveyed using semi-structured, open-ended questionnaires. On the western side, only one study site (Indarason) was found to be vulnerable driven by variables such as a depleted coastal ecology and a lack of socioeconomic adaptive capability (specifically, a lack of environmental awareness and community activities). Overall, however, the western side of Kudat demonstrated a higher adaptive capacity for fisheries, coastal ecosystems, and socioeconomic development. While, on the eastern side, three study sites (Tajau Laut, Tanjong Kapor and Landung Ayang) are highly vulnerable across three aspects: fisheries, socio-economic and coastal ecosystem components. This eastern side of Kudat was particularly vulnerable to climate change due to its high sensitivity and low adaptive capacity in these three components. This study suggested that developing climate-resilient small-scale fisheries was vital, as they were integral to sustainable development and food security in many coastal communities.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究旨在评估马来西亚沙巴古达小规模渔业对潜在风暴潮的脆弱性，采用TURF（Tool for Understanding Resilience of Fisheries）框架对九个热带研究站点进行气候变化脆弱性评估，并于2020年3月至2023年3月通过半结构化开放式问卷对100名受访者开展实地访谈。结果显示，古达西侧仅Indarason一个站点因沿岸生态退化和社会经济适应能力不足（尤其是环境意识和社区活动缺乏）而表现为脆弱，但西侧整体在渔业、沿岸生态系统和社会经济发展方面具有较高的适应能力；东侧三个站点（Tajau Laut、Tanjong Kapor和Landung Ayang）在渔业、社会经济和沿岸生态系统三个维度均高度脆弱，主要归因于高敏感性和低适应能力。研究建议发展气候韧性小规模渔业，因其对沿海社区可持续发展和粮食安全至关重要。

papers.title: Conflict with industrial fleets undermines the contributions of small-scale fisheries to sustainable development in vulnerable regions
papers.authors: Cronin, Melissa R.; Finkbeiner, Elena; Virdin, John; Carmine, Gabrielle; Dalton, Kathryn H.; Fitzpatrick, Juno; Hicks, Christina C.; Mancha-Cisneros, Maria del Mar; Basurto, Xavier
papers.summary_cn: 该研究探讨工业船队与小规模渔业之间的冲突如何削弱后者对可持续发展的贡献，重点关注脆弱地区。基于标题推断，研究可能通过空间分析或案例比较识别冲突热点区域，并评估其对粮食安全与生计的影响。

papers.title: Floating Carp Hatchery on Tapi (Ukai) Reservoir: A Tool for In-situ Carp Seed Production in Reservoir Fisheries
papers.authors: Pithiya, Kuldip G.; Kandoriya, B. A.; Lende, S. R.
papers.abstract: Background: Reservoir stocking can depend on carp seed supplied from land-based hatcheries, with associated transport and handling requirements. This study evaluated a floating hatchery installed on Ukai (Tapi) Reservoir, Gujarat, for in situ breeding, incubation and spawn collection of three Indian major carps. Methods: Field trials were conducted during June–August 2025. A modular platform supported plastic-coated breeding, incubation and spawn-collection units. Reservoir-caught broodstock of Labeo catla, Labeo rohita and Cirrhinus mrigala were conditioned in adjacent floating cages for 21 days before hormone-induced breeding. Three replicate trials were conducted per species. Water quality was measured three times daily, and differences among species were assessed by one-way analysis of variance. Results: Fertilisation rates were 79.4%, 76.2% and 79.5% for L. catla, L. rohita and C. mrigala, respectively. Corresponding hatching success rates were 66.5%, 65.0% and 60.0%, while 72-hour spawn survival rates were 68.2%, 60.5% and 65.0%. Hatchery water temperature ranged from 27.2 to 29.5 °C, dissolved oxygen from 6.2 to 7.4 mg L⁻¹, and pH from 7.5 to 8.2. The floating platform maintained pitch and roll below 2.5° under the monitored wind conditions. The reported operational comparison indicated no road-transit time for directly released spawn and a reduction in cost per 100,000 spawn from ₹3,200 to ₹1,450. Conclusion: Under the monitored reservoir conditions, the floating hatchery supported in situ carp seed production while avoiding road transport of spawn.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究在印度古吉拉特邦Ukai（Tapi）水库试验了一种浮式孵化平台，用于三种印度主要鲤科鱼类（Labeo catla、L. rohita、Cirrhinus mrigala）的原位催产、孵化和鱼苗收集。水库捕获的亲鱼经浮动网箱暂养21天后进行激素诱导繁殖，每种鱼重复3次试验。结果显示受精率79.4%、76.2%、79.5%，孵化率66.5%、65.0%、60.0%，72小时鱼苗存活率68.2%、60.5%、65.0%，孵化水质条件适宜，平台在监测风况下横摇与纵摇均低于2.5°。该浮式孵化系统可实现水库原位鲤苗生产，省去鱼苗陆路运输环节，每10万尾鱼苗成本由₹3,200降至₹1,450。

papers.title: Implementing BBNJ across fisheries institutions: policy options for interoperable ocean governance
papers.authors: Nam, Wanwoo
papers.abstract: The entry into force of the Agreement under the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea on the Conservation and Sustainable Use of Marine Biological Diversity of Areas beyond National Jurisdiction (BBNJ Agreement) creates a practical implementation problem for fisheries governance. Biodiversity information, area-based management, environmental assessment, fisheries authorization, vessel identity, port measures, maritime safety and market controls are governed by institutions that were not designed as a single compliance system. This Policy and Practice Review uses a structured qualitative institutional appraisal to compare four governance architectures—autonomous implementation, centralized integration, sectoral liaison, and federated interoperability with phased implementation. The method specifies a source hierarchy, four units of comparison, six pre-defined criteria, and an evidence-to-finding protocol that distinguishes existing-authority fit, conditional adaptation and structural constraint. Each finding is tied to treaty text, official institutional material and relevant peer-reviewed scholarship available through 31 August 2026. The legal foundation for cross-regime coexistence is anchored in BBNJ Agreement articles 5(2), 22, 29, 47(6)(c) and 51, which combine non-undermining, cooperation and coordination, respect for institutional competences, and links to existing information mechanisms. The comparison does not claim to predict governmental policy choices or empirically prove an optimal design. Instead, it identifies institutionally workable options under stated legal and administrative constraints. On that basis, federated interoperability is carried forward as a conditional policy proposition for staged testing, subject to provenance controls, verification and legal assessment by the competent authorities, cybersecurity, capacity support and review. The article proposes a three-stage pathway—pre-COP mapping, first-COP institutionalization, and post-COP pilots and review—linking BBNJ bodies, RFMOs, FAO/PSMA mechanisms, IMO-related systems and national administrations.
papers.summary_cn: 本文针对BBNJ协定生效后渔业治理面临的跨机构实施难题，采用结构化定性制度评估方法，比较自主实施、集中整合、部门联络与联邦式互操作四种治理架构。基于BBNJ协定第5(2)、22、29、47(6)(c)和51条的法律基础，研究识别出在既定法律与行政约束下制度上可行的方案，并将分阶段实施的联邦式互操作作为有条件政策建议推进。文章提出会前梳理、首次缔约方会议制度化、会后试点与审查的三阶段路径，以衔接BBNJ机构、RFMOs、FAO/PSMA机制、IMO相关系统及国家主管部门。

papers.title: FISHERMEN'S PERCEPTIONS OF REFRIGERATED COOL BOX TECHNOLOGY FOR CATCH HANDLING IN SMALL-SCALE FISHERIES IN CILINCING, NORTH JAKARTA
papers.authors: Imron, Mohammad; Baskoro, Mulyono S.; Wisudo, Sugeng H.; Purwangka, Fis; Mulyadi, Rama Agus
papers.abstract: Immediate handling of fish catches is important for maintaining the quality of small-scale fishery products. Ice is commonly used, but storage space, procurement, transportation, and handling may pose challenges for fishers operating small vessels. This study examined fishers’ assessments of a 60 L refrigerated cool box as a catch-handling technology in Cilincing, North Jakarta. A descriptive quantitative approach involved 45 fishers, including swimming-crab fishers and fishers using various types of nets. Perceptions were measured using 10 indicators and a three-point agreement scale. Across 450 responses, 80.00% indicated agreement, 14.44% were neutral, and 5.56% indicated disagreement. The total score was 1,235 out of a maximum of 1,350, equivalent to a mean score of 2.74 on a 1–3 scale and a score-to-maximum index of 91.48%. The highest index concerned the perceived ability to maintain catch quality (94.81%), while the lowest concerned the potential to increase fishers’ income (86.67%). The response proportion and score index represent different measures and are reported separately. These findings describe respondents’ agreement with the potential benefits of the technology; they do not demonstrate actual improvements in product quality, operating costs, income, or technology adoption. Key words: catch handling, Cilincing, cooling, fishermen’s perception, refrigerated cool box, small-scale fishers
papers.summary_cn: 本研究调查了北雅加达Cilincing小规模渔业渔民对60 L冷藏保温箱作为渔获处理技术的认知，采用描述性定量方法对45名渔民（包括梭子蟹渔民及多种网具渔民）进行10项指标的三级同意度评估。450份应答中80.00%表示同意，总得分指数为91.48%（均分2.74/3），其中保持渔获品质能力指标最高（94.81%），增加收入潜力指标最低（86.67%）。结果仅反映渔民对该技术潜在益处的认同，并未证实产品品质、运营成本、收入或技术采纳方面的实际改善。

papers.title: Coastal Ecosystem Conditions as Ecological Basis for Traditional Fisheries Productivity in Lakudo Central Buton Regency
papers.authors: Sasmita, Farra; Latif, Wa O.U.; Harudin, La; Hastian; Innayah, Nur
papers.abstract: Indonesia's coastal areas encompass important ecosystems such as mangroves, seagrass beds, and coral reefs, which play a role in supporting capture fisheries productivity. However, ecosystem degradation due to human activities has the potential to reduce habitat quality and the availability of fish resources for traditional fishermen. This study aims to assess the condition of the coastal ecosystem in Lakudo Village and analyze its role as an ecological foundation for traditional fishermen's capture fisheries productivity. The study used a descriptive qualitative approach with a case study method. Primary data were obtained through semi-structured interviews with traditional fishermen and field documentation, while secondary data came from village reports and scientific publications. Data analysis was conducted thematically to identify the socio-ecological relationships between coastal ecosystem conditions and fisheries productivity. The research results indicate that seagrass beds and coral reefs continue to support capture fisheries, while the presence of mangroves at the study site is relatively limited. Fishers have also reported a downward trend in their catch over the last three years, which is attributed to an increase in the number of fishers and competition for the utilization of fish resources. The results of the study are expected to support sustainable coastal resource management and strengthen local community food security. Keywords: coastal ecosystems; capture fisheries; productivity; mangrove–seagrass; fishermen Abstrak Wilayah pesisir Indonesia memiliki ekosistem penting seperti mangrove, padang lamun, dan terumbu karang yang berperan dalam mendukung produktivitas perikanan tangkap. Namun, degradasi ekosistem akibat aktivitas manusia berpotensi menurunkan kualitas habitat dan ketersediaan sumber daya ikan bagi nelayan tradisional. Penelitian ini bertujuan mengkaji kondisi ekosistem pesisir Desa Lakudo serta menganalisis perannya sebagai landasan ekologis produktivitas perikanan tangkap nelayan tradisional. Penelitian menggunakan pendekatan kualitatif deskriptif dengan metode studi kasus. Data primer diperoleh melalui wawancara semi-terstruktur dengan nelayan tradisional dan dokumentasi lapangan, sedangkan data sekunder berasal dari laporan desa dan publikasi ilmiah. Analisis data dilakukan secara tematik untuk mengidentifikasi hubungan sosial-ekologis antara kondisi ekosistem pesisir dan produktivitas perikanan. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa padang lamun dan terumbu karang masih mendukung aktivitas perikanan tangkap, sedangkan keberadaan mangrove di lokasi penelitian relatif terbatas. Nelayan juga melaporkan kecenderungan penurunan hasil tangkapan dalam tiga tahun terakhir, yang dikaitkan dengan meningkatnya jumlah nelayan dan persaingan pemanfaatan sumber daya ikan. Temuan ini diharapkan mendukung pengelolaan sumber daya pesisir yang berkelanjutan serta memperkuat ketahanan pangan masyarakat lokal. Kata kunci: ekosistem pesisir; perikanan tangkap; produktivitas; mangrove–lamun; nelayan
papers.summary_cn: 本研究旨在评估印尼Lakudo村沿海生态系统（海草床、珊瑚礁、红树林）状况，并分析其作为传统渔民捕捞渔业生产力生态基础的作用，采用半结构化访谈与主题分析的描述性定性案例研究方法。结果显示海草床和珊瑚礁仍支撑着捕捞渔业活动，而红树林分布相对有限；渔民报告近三年渔获量呈下降趋势，归因于渔民数量增加及对鱼类资源的竞争加剧。研究建议加强沿海资源可持续管理以保障当地社区粮食安全。

papers.title: Beyond Nutrition: Seaweeds as Functional Resources for Fish, Poultry and Ruminant Health, Production and Sustainability
papers.authors: Maske, Vaishali Gautam; Karhale, Akash Vishwanath; Iwanate, Neha Tikaram; Solanke, Bhushan Gajanan
papers.abstract: Seaweeds are increasingly investigated as functional feed resources, yet extrapolation from biochemical activity to better animal health, productive efficiency and environmental performance remains uncertain. This critical narrative review integrates evidence for macroalgal meals, extracts and characterised metabolites in finfish, broiler chickens, laying hens and ruminants, with particular attention to mechanisms, exposure, product safety and sustainability. Peer-reviewed studies and relevant methodological reviews published between 2014 and 12 August 2026 were considered through accessible scholarly indexes, citation searching and journal records. Across animal systems, responses depend on algal taxonomy, growing conditions, processing, dietary concentration, basal ration and physiological context. In fish, changes in innate immune markers and intestinal characteristics are more consistently reported than durable improvements in growth or disease resistance; a tilapia meta-analysis found no significant overall growth or feed-conversion advantage for seaweed-containing diets. In poultry, some controlled studies and a small meta-analysis indicate improvements in performance or intestinal indices, whereas trials in breeders identify limited reproductive benefits and potential iodine transfer. In ruminants, bromoform-containing Asparagopsis can substantially suppress enteric methane, but effects differ between housed and grazing settings, may diminish with storage or prolonged feeding, and can coincide with lower feed intake or increased iodine and bromide in milk. Across systems, contaminant speciation, mineral transfer, feed palatability, resource use and the emissions of cultivation and processing constrain claims of sustainability. The most defensible conclusion is that particular, quality-controlled seaweed preparations can deliver defined functional effects in particular production contexts; seaweed inclusion as a general strategy for healthier animals and climate-neutral production is not established. Research should prioritise exposure-standardised trials, clinically meaningful outcomes, residue surveillance, farm-scale replication and consequential environmental assessment.
papers.summary_cn: 该综述批判性评估海藻作为功能性饲料资源在鱼类、家禽和反刍动物中的应用证据，重点关注作用机制、暴露水平、产品安全性与可持续性。综合2014—2026年同行评议研究，发现动物响应高度依赖海藻分类、加工方式、日粮浓度及生理背景；鱼类中免疫与肠道指标变化较一致，但罗非鱼meta分析未显示整体生长或饲料转化优势，反刍动物中含溴仿的Asparagopsis可显著抑制肠道甲烷但效果受饲养模式影响且伴随碘/溴残留风险。结论认为仅特定经质量控控的海藻制剂在特定生产情境下具有明确功能效应，海藻作为普遍性健康与气候中性生产策略尚未成立，未来需优先开展暴露标准化试验、临床意义明确的结局指标、残留监测及农场尺度环境评估。

papers.title: Stage-resolved multi-omics reveals broad developmental preservation and localized molecular remodeling in cold-shock-induced triploid fish embryos
papers.authors: Long, Feng; Shao, Wen; Xiao, Junzhu; Chen, Sijing; Chen, Lin; Li, Yin; Weng, Huasong; Pu, Fei; Zhou, Tao; Li, Ning
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Increased genome dosage can alter cellular and regulatory states, yet how vertebrate embryos maintain coordinated developmental progression following a whole-genome dosage increase remains unclear. Results Here, we examined developmental, transcriptomic, and DNA methylation patterns during cold-shock-induced triploid embryogenesis in large yellow croaker ( Larimichthys crocea ). Triploid embryos exhibited approximately 1.51-fold higher DNA content and reached major developmental stages at times comparable with diploid controls. Across eight stages, developmental stage rather than ploidy dominated global RNA-seq variation, indicating broad preservation of relative transcriptome composition. Stage-wise comparisons identified localized transcriptional differences concentrated primarily at the blastula and heartbeat stages. Stage-by-ploidy interaction analysis revealed distinct developmental expression trajectories involving RNA processing, embryonic patterning, extracellular matrix organization, and contractile development. Whole-genome bisulfite sequencing at three stages revealed extensive and bidirectional regional methylation differences. Relative to analyzable genomic windows, differentially methylated regions showed non-random enrichment across genomic contexts, including particularly strong enrichment in CpG islands and promoters. However, methylation–expression correlations across promoter, gene-body, exonic, and intronic contexts were uniformly weak. Among RNA-testable differentially methylated genes, only seven genes at the blastula stage and two at the heartbeat stage were also differentially expressed, and these overlaps were not greater than expected under independence. Conclusions Cold-shock-induced triploid embryos therefore retain broadly preserved developmental progression and relative transcriptome organization while exhibiting localized transcriptional differences and extensive, genomically structured methylation remodeling. The limited same-stage correspondence between methylation and expression indicates that regional methylation differences are not broadly associated with concurrent transcriptional divergence in bulk embryos.
papers.summary_cn: 以大黄鱼（Larimichthys crocea）冷休克诱导三倍体胚胎为对象，结合发育观察、转录组测序和全基因组亚硫酸氢盐测序，解析全基因组剂量增加后胚胎发育与分子调控的维持机制。三倍体胚胎DNA含量约为二倍体的1.51倍，但各主要发育阶段到达时间与二倍体对照相当，且发育阶段而非倍性主导全局转录组变异，表明相对转录组组成广泛保守。阶段比较显示转录差异主要集中于囊胚期和心跳期，涉及RNA加工、胚胎模式建成、细胞外基质组织及收缩性发育等过程；甲基化差异广泛且呈双向分布，在CpG岛和启动子区显著富集，但甲基化与表达的同期相关性普遍较弱。研究表明冷休克诱导三倍体胚胎在保持发育进程和转录组整体组织保守的同时，存在局部转录差异及广泛且具基因组结构特征的甲基化重塑。

papers.title: Seasonal and Spatial Distribution of Ichthyofauna of Lake Toho after 2018’s Mass Fish Mortality Events
papers.authors: Kpera, Mouhamed Orou Nari Chabi; Lingofo, Roger Bolaya; Abou, Youssouf
papers.journal: Asian Journal of Fisheries and Aquatic Research
papers.abstract: Aims: This study aimed to assess the composition and diversity of the ichthyofauna of Lake Toho across sampling sites and seasons following the 2018 mass fish mortality event. Study Design: This was a comparative ecological study assessing fish species composition and diversity across different sites and seasons. Place and Duration of Study: Lake Toho, February to December 2024 Methodology: Sampling was carried out bimonthly at two sampling sites. Standard water physicochemical parameters were measured in situ. Fish sampling was conducted using standardised experimental fishing methods, namely fine-mesh seines and gillnets. In addition, catches from local fishermen were examined to complement the information obtained on fish diversity. Samples were preserved in 10% (v/v) formalin solution. In the laboratory, fish specimens were subsequently transferred to 90% ethanol and identified using taxonomic keys. Diversity indices were calculated. A two-way analysis of variance (ANOVA) was performed to evaluate the effects of sampling site and season. Results: Except for dissolved oxygen (range 2.52-3.32 mg/L), all measured water physicochemical parameters were suitable for freshwater aquatic organisms. A total of four orders, seven families, and 14 fish species were sampled. Cichlidae was the dominant family, accounting for 98% of the total abundance and comprising six species. Sarotherodon melanotheron, Oreochromis niloticus, and Coptodon guineensis were ubiquitous species. Species richness varied from 12 species at site Z1 to 13 species at site Z2. It ranged between 8 species during the short dry season and 11 species during the high rainy season. Simpson index (range 0.44-0.62), Shannon index (range 0.82-1.25), and equitability (range 0.44-0.60) showed no significant differences between sites (P > 0.05) and seasons (P > 0.05), indicating low and homogeneous fish diversity. No significant site × season interaction was observed for fish abundance or diversity indices (P > 0.05). Conclusion: These findings suggest that fish diversity may be influenced by multiple anthropogenic pressures and underscore the need for enhanced monitoring, conservation, and sustainable management of Lake Toho.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究旨在评估2018年大规模鱼类死亡事件后Toho湖鱼类区系的组成与多样性在采样站点和季节间的变化。2024年2月至12月在两站点进行双月采样，采用细目刺网和流刺网标准化试验捕捞，并结合渔民渔获物，计算多样性指数并用双因素方差分析检验站点与季节效应。共记录4目7科14种鱼，Cichlidae为优势科（占总丰度98%，含6种），Simpson、Shannon及均匀度指数在站点和季节间均无显著差异（P>0.05），多样性整体偏低且均质。除溶解氧（2.52–3.32 mg/L）外，各项水质参数均适宜淡水生物，结果表明鱼类多样性可能受多重人为压力影响，需加强监测与可持续管理。

papers.title: TriLock-FISH enables in situ discrimination of influenza cRNA and mRNA for single-cell analysis of viral replication and transcription
papers.authors: Zhang, Lingkai; Chen, Wei; Gao, Xinyu; Cai, Huaiyuan; Zhou, Xu; Ullah, Rizwan; Pei, Xinyi; Dai, Jinxia; Cao, Gang; Peng, Guiqing
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Influenza A virus produces three RNA species—viral RNA (vRNA), complementary RNA (cRNA), and messenger RNA (mRNA)—whose synthesis and trafficking are spatially compartmentalized. However, the high sequence similarity between cRNA and mRNA hinders their distinction in situ , limiting understanding of the spatial organization of the viral replication-transcription dynamics. Here, triple-lock fluorescence in situ hybridization (TriLock-FISH) was developed to distinguish vRNA, cRNA, and mRNA in situ with high specificity. TriLock-FISH enabled a genome-wide, time-resolved single-cell atlas of RNA abundance and localization, revealing marked cell-to-cell variation in RNA abundance but relatively conserved spatial organization. cRNA was found to be predominantly nuclear, with a small but reproducible cytoplasmic fraction. Application to infected mouse lung tissue demonstrated simultaneous spatial detection of all viral RNA species. This approach provides a highly specific framework for single-cell analysis of RNA virus replication and transcription. IMPORTANCE Influenza virus relies on three closely related RNA molecules for replication and gene expression, yet distinguishing them inside infected cells has remained technically challenging. This limitation has hindered understanding of viral replication in space and time. We developed triple-lock fluorescence in situ hybridization, which enables simultaneous visualization of all three viral RNA species across all eight influenza genome segments in infected cells and tissues. Single-cell analysis revealed striking heterogeneity in viral RNA abundance across infected cells, whereas intracellular RNA localization patterns remained relatively conserved. Complementary RNA, a replication intermediate long thought to be strictly nuclear, was also detected at low levels in the cytoplasm. These findings provide new insight into influenza virus replication and establish a broadly applicable tool for studying RNA virus biology.
papers.summary_cn: 开发TriLock-FISH技术以高特异性原位区分甲型流感病毒的vRNA、cRNA和mRNA，克服cRNA与mRNA序列高度相似难以区分的难题。该方法实现了全基因组、时间分辨的单细胞RNA丰度与定位图谱，发现感染细胞间RNA丰度异质性显著而空间组织相对保守，cRNA主要定位于核内但存在少量可重复检测的胞质组分。在感染小鼠肺组织中实现了全部病毒RNA种类的同步空间检测，为RNA病毒复制与转录的单细胞研究提供了高特异性工具。

papers.title: White Feces Syndrome is closely linked to impaired antioxidant capacity, the aquaculture environment, and microbial dysbiosis in Litopenaeus vannamei reared in small-pond culture system
papers.authors: Wang, Zhuoduo; Zhang, Xin; Xv, Kangze; Luthfiah, Adinda; Jiang, Yongjie; Zhao, Limei; Tan, Beiping; Zhang, Wei
papers.abstract: Background White feces syndrome (WFS) is a major health problem affecting intensive shrimp aquaculture, but its underlying mechanisms remain unclear. Increasing evidence suggests that WFS may involve complex interactions among host physiological status, intestinal microbial dysbiosis, and environmental microbial communities. However, the relationships among these factors within commercial shrimp culture systems remain poorly understood. Objectives This study aimed to investigate the associations among intestinal antioxidant capacity, intestinal microbiota, sediment microbial communities, and water quality parameters in Litopenaeus vannamei affected by WFS under small-pond culture conditions. Methods Healthy and WFS-affected shrimp were collected from a commercial shrimp farm in Zhanjiang, Guangdong Province, China. Intestinal antioxidant parameters, including total antioxidant capacity (T-AOC), superoxide dismutase (SOD), glutathione peroxidase (GSH-Px), and malondialdehyde (MDA), were determined. Intestinal and sediment microbial communities were analyzed using 16S rRNA gene sequencing. Water quality parameters and microbial community composition were compared between healthy and WFS groups. Results Compared with healthy shrimp, WFS-affected shrimp exhibited significantly increased intestinal MDA levels and decreased activities of T-AOC, SOD, and GSH-Px, indicating an imbalance in antioxidant status. Significant differences in intestinal microbial community composition were observed between groups, as confirmed by beta-diversity analysis (PERMANOVA, R 2 = 0.407, P = 0.022). WFS-associated microbial alterations included changes in dominant bacterial taxa and predicted microbial functional potential related to metabolism. The dominant taxa, referring to the most abundant microbial groups based on relative abundance, differed between healthy and WFS-affected shrimp. Sediment microbial communities also showed substantial compositional shifts, suggesting alterations in the surrounding microbial environment. In addition, nitrate and total nitrogen concentrations were significantly reduced in the WFS group. Conclusion These findings indicate that WFS occurrence is associated with coordinated alterations in shrimp antioxidant status, intestinal microbial structure, sediment microbial communities, and environmental conditions. This study provides new insights into WFS from a host–microbiota–environment interaction perspective and highlights potential indicators for monitoring shrimp health in aquaculture systems.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究针对小棚养殖模式下凡纳滨对虾（Litopenaeus vannamei）白便综合征（WFS），比较了健康与患病虾的肠道抗氧化指标、肠道及沉积物微生物群落（16S rRNA测序）和水质参数。结果显示，患病虾肠道MDA显著升高、T-AOC/SOD/GSH-Px活性下降，肠道菌群组成显著改变（PERMANOVA，R²=0.407，P=0.022），沉积物菌群亦发生明显变化，且硝酸盐和总氮浓度显著降低。研究表明WFS与宿主抗氧化能力受损、肠道菌群失调及养殖环境微生物变化协同相关，为从宿主-微生物-环境互作角度监测对虾健康提供了潜在指标。

papers.title: Valorization of Aquaculture Waste Through Conversion into Algal Biomass and Biomethane
papers.authors: Ziganshina, Elvira E.; Bulynina, Svetlana S.; Ziganshin, Ayrat M.
papers.abstract: Uneaten feed and feces are major sources of waste in aquaculture systems, which lead to the eutrophication of water bodies. This study proposes a multidisciplinary approach to the valorization of two types of aquaculture waste. The first component of the strategy is the cultivation of microalgae in raw wastewater. The wastewater from a recirculation aquaculture system (RAS) for sturgeon was tested as an alternative growth medium for eight microalgae species. The highest biomass concentration was achieved when cultivating Tetradesmus obliquus, reaching 1.34 ± 0.04 g L–1. Anaerobic digestion (AD) of sludge from the RAS and mixed algal biomass harvested from wastewater treatment was proposed as a secondary component of a waste valorization strategy. Granular activated carbon (GAC) was selected as the conductive material to enhance methane production from tested substrates. The specific methane production (SMP) during AD of the sludge ranged from 94 to 99 NmL g–1VS (volatile solids). In contrast, the SMP for treatments containing algae reached 321–327 NmL g–1VS. The addition of GAC to the anaerobic reactors was an effective method for enhancing methane formation from algal biomass. Finally, this study combines aquaculture water treatment and sludge management with the production of valuable algal biomass and biofuel.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究探讨水产养殖废弃物（残饵和粪便）的资源化利用，采用多学科策略：以 sturgeon RAS 废水培养8种微藻，其中 Tetradesmus obliquus 生物量最高（1.34 ± 0.04 g L–1）；同时对 RAS 污泥与混合藻类生物质进行厌氧消化（AD），并添加颗粒活性炭（GAC）促进甲烷产出。结果显示藻类处理组甲烷比产量（SMP）达321–327 NmL g–1VS，显著高于污泥组的94–99 NmL g–1VS，GAC 可有效提升藻类生物质的甲烷生成。该研究将养殖水处理与污泥管理同高值藻类生物质及生物燃料生产相结合。

papers.title: Assessment of the reproductive biology of largetooth silverside <i>Chirostoma arge</i> (Atherinopsidae) in Lake Chapala, Mexico
papers.authors: Gomez Vanega, Hosmer Duvan; López Uriarte, Ernesto
papers.abstract: Chirostoma arge (Jordan and Snyder, 1899) is a fish endemic to the central plateau of Mexico important for fishing in natural reservoirs such as Lake Chapala. Unfortunately, little is known about this species of the Atherinopsidae family, which is listed as Data Deficient by the IUCN Red List. This study’s objective was to determine the sex ratio, the stage of gonadal maturity in each sex, the spawning season and to estimate the relative condition factor, the minimum standard length and the standard length at first maturity. It analyzed a 3195 fish specimens caught by fishers from six landing sites during an annual cycle. The sex ratio was significantly skewed toward males; however, females recorded a higher mean weight and length than males. Spawning in both sexes began in March and lasted until July. The monthly gonadosomatic index values showed significant increases in females and males from January to May. The monthly variation in condition factor showed a significant increase from November to May. The standard length at first maturity or L50 in females (80.4 mm SL) was slightly greater than in males (77.8 mm SL). The mean fecundity was 1778 eggs (±582 SD). A positive correlation was found between fecundity and ovary weight. This study provides biological and fisheries data on the reproductive activity of one of the most abundant species of silverside, C. arge, in Mexico’s largest lake, Lake Chapala.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究旨在填补墨西哥查帕拉湖特有鱼类Chirostoma arge（IUCN列为数据缺乏）繁殖生物学空白，基于全年六个卸鱼点3195尾样本，分析了性比、性腺成熟度、产卵季节、相对条件因子及初次性成熟体长。结果显示性比显著偏雄，但雌鱼平均体重和体长更大；雌雄产卵期均为3–7月，性腺体指数1–5月显著上升；雌鱼L50（80.4 mm SL）略大于雄鱼（77.8 mm SL），平均繁殖力1778粒（±582 SD），与卵巢重呈正相关。该研究为这一查帕拉湖优势银汉鱼种的繁殖活动提供了生物学与渔业基础数据。

papers.title: Evaluating environmental DNA metabarcoding for describing freshwater fish and shellfish occurrence in an Eastern Cascades watershed
papers.authors: Wolf, Skylar; Crosson, Lisa; Winkowski, Marie
papers.journal: North American Journal of Fisheries Management
papers.abstract: Abstract Objective Environmental DNA (eDNA) metabarcoding offers a promising, cost-effective tool to collect data across a large spatial scale, but analyzing these data poses several critical decisions that are uncommon to traditional field sampling. The objective of our study was to evaluate data collection, filtering, and analytical components of occurrence data generated using an eDNA metabarcoding approach. Methods During 2024, we collected replicated water samples from 89 sites distributed across the Wenatchee River Hydrologic Unit Code 8 watershed located in eastern Washington. We processed samples using two metabarcoding markers that targeted the cytochrome c oxidase subunit 1 (CO1; Leray-XT) or 12S ribosomal RNA (MiFish-U) mitochondrial gene region, and we summarized differences in detection, taxonomic coverage, and data filtering requirements for each marker. Finalized metabarcoding data were used to fit occupancy models within a Bayesian framework. We evaluated model results with a focus on species-specific detection probability, the stability of predictions using the full data set and reduced numbers of visited sites, and comparisons between fitting models using a single-species or multispecies occupancy model approach. Results The metabarcoding approach generated detections for 26 unique taxonomic assignment groups that closely matched species-level assignments for fish and shellfish. Taxonomic coverage and resolution were greater using the CO1 marker, but the MiFish-U marker appeared to be more sensitive to detections. We found that setting data filtering criteria was an important component of finalizing results—for example, defining minimum read thresholds for detections generated using the MiFish-U marker. Occupancy modeling suggested a high detection probability for most species. Additionally, basinwide estimates of occurrence were comparable between single-species and multispecies models, with increased precision apparent for many species using the multispecies approach. Conclusions Collectively, we combined contemporary sampling and analytical approaches to investigate inland fish and shellfish occurrence at a watershed scale. We provide researchers and managers with important considerations for metabarcoding-based monitoring projects. Additionally, our results provide eDNA-inferred occupancy predictions for freshwater species in an eastern Washington watershed.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究评估了eDNA metabarcoding在描述淡水鱼类和贝类分布中的数据采集、过滤及分析环节。2024年在Wenatchee河流域89个站点采集水样，比较CO1（Leray-XT）和12S（MiFish-U）两种标记在检测率、分类覆盖度和数据过滤需求上的差异，并以贝叶斯框架拟合occupancy models。结果显示CO1标记分类分辨率和覆盖度更高，而MiFish-U检测灵敏度更强；多数物种检测概率较高，单物种与多物种模型的全流域occurrence估计相当，多物种方法精度更优。研究为基于metabarcoding的监测项目提供了关键方法学参考及该流域淡水物种的eDNA occupancy预测。

papers.title: Quality Characteristics and Frozen Storage Stability of Grass Carp (Ctenopharyngodon idella) Fish Fingers: A Comparative Evaluation of Fried and Baked Products
papers.authors: Jena, Geetanjali; Sahu, Brundaban; Tripathy, Manoj Kumar; Pati, Bikash Kumar; Roul, Chandan; Patro, Suryamani; Priyadarshini, Pooja
papers.journal: European Journal of Nutrition & Food Safety
papers.abstract: This study investigated the quality characteristics and frozen storage stability of grass carp (Ctenopharyngodon idella) fish fingers, including a comparison of fried and baked products. Fish fingers prepared from minced grass carp meat, with a meat yield of 34.21 ± 2.1%, contained 65.70 ± 1.9% moisture, 17.06 ± 1.1% crude protein, 3.14 ± 0.9% crude fat and 2.20 ± 0.6% ash. During storage at −20°C for 180 days, moisture decreased to 61.59 ± 0.8%, accompanied by a relative increase in the other proximate components. Quality deterioration remained gradual, with TVBN increasing from 4.24 ± 0.4 to 9.91 ± 0.8 mg%, peroxide value from 6.68 ± 0.9 to 10.16 ± 0.8 mmol O₂/kg fat, and FFA from 2.68 ± 0.2 to 8.03 ± 0.6%, indicating limited lipid hydrolysis and oxidation during frozen storage. The total plate count decreased from 2.67 × 10³ to 0.089 × 10³ CFU/g, while sensory evaluation showed good acceptability after 180 days, with an overall acceptability score of 4.0/5.0. Comparison of the cooking methods showed that baked fish fingers had lower crude fat (13.75 ± 1.20%), TVBN (6.37 ± 0.80 mg%), peroxide value (7.54 ± 0.70 mmol O₂/kg fat) and FFA (3.28 ± 0.30%) than fried fingers, which contained 16.02 ± 1.10% fat. Baked fingers also achieved an overall sensory score of 5.0. These findings demonstrate that grass carp is suitable for value-added fish finger production with good frozen storage stability, while baking provides a lower-fat preparation method while retaining high sensory acceptability. The product therefore has potential for convenient ready-to-cook applications and improved utilisation of grass carp through value addition.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究以草鱼（Ctenopharyngodon idella）鱼糜制作鱼柳（fish fingers），比较油炸与烘焙产品的品质特征及−20°C冻藏180天的稳定性。结果显示，冻藏期间水分由65.70%降至61.59%，TVBN、过氧化值和FFA均缓慢上升，脂质水解与氧化程度有限，菌落总数下降，180天后感官总体可接受性达4.0/5.0。烘焙产品较油炸产品脂肪含量更低（13.75% vs 16.02%），TVBN、过氧化值和FFA亦更低，感官评分达5.0。研究表明草鱼适于加工高附加值鱼柳且冻藏稳定性良好，烘焙为低脂且感官可接受性高的制备方式。
